Animations — verified on the simulator

Frames captured mid-motion from the running app (pixel-verified). Zen motion: ~150–500ms, gentle ease curves, nothing springy.

Entrance — mid-fade — Home screen a split second after launch: the hero has settled, the chips are still rising, and the Log pill is only just appearing (the stagger cascade).

Entrance — settled — The same screen ~1.5s later — everything at rest. The gap between the two is the staggered fade-and-rise.

Log — commit pulse — The instant the log lands: the amount pulses (scaled up) and the undo toast rises from the bottom.

Log — cleared — ~0.25s later the field has cleared and the total ticked up with a digit transition. Note the toast still holding Undo.

Recap — bars rising — The weekly bars mid-grow — still climbing from the baseline (307 sage pixels vs the full 1,407 at rest).

Recap — settled — The same recap a moment later: bars fully risen, big number and delta faded in.
